objective: Held-out advertisement AUC above0.85, primarily by a modern model architecture; final scoring remains deferred
hypothesis: Shared metadata priors added no new target preference information. Add label-derived collaborative neighborhoods while protecting the trained backbone as a controlled alternative.
architecture: Modern TabM with a separate attention branch over users who clicked the candidate ad and ads clicked by the current user; user vectors anchored in frozen source-news preference pretraining; fuse neighbor matching through a context gate

data.positive_edges: 15293 unique user-task pairs from advertisement training labels only
data.source_vectors: Audited source_graph_teacher_day16 user vectors, mapped through the exact ad user vocabulary; frozen
data.ad_metadata: Training-X-only task metadata prototypes or full observed attribute links; do not assume all task attributes are unique
data.mixed_pairs: 11183 clicked user-task pairs also have nonclick rows, so neighborhood evidence must not be interpreted as deterministic target labels

query_exclusion: Exclude the queried user-task edge from BOTH user and candidate-ad neighborhoods for training and validation queries
Remove the query before limiting the neighbor count; a K+1 sorted reservoir supports deterministic K-neighbor selection without self-edge sampling leakage
Subtract the query edge from any label-derived degree/confidence count, even if the query node is outside the stored neighbor prefix
Use full sorted positive pair keys for membership; never expose the membership flag as a feature
Frozen source user vectors and task metadata inputs must not depend on advertisement query labels
No aggregation from later advertisement history snapshots; no advertisement validation labels in graph construction, fitting or gradients
tests_required: Flipping only the queried training label cannot change its returned neighborhoods or adjusted degrees
Self-exclusion remains invariant at, inside and beyond the neighbor-cap boundary
Unknown/PAD nodes cannot create shared neighbor hubs; real raw category0 keeps its encoded identity
Empty neighborhoods return finite outputs and source/metadata fallback representations
Current user query changes attention over other clickers; current ad query changes attention over other clicked ads
Saved graph indices, source mappings and model predictions reload exactly
controls: A new branch with no collaborative messages, using the same parameters and initialization
A query-excluded collaborative-attention branch on the identical fixed random20 indices
Consider a protected strong TabM32 backbone first; compare full fine-tuning only as a separately identified experiment
success_evidence: Replay all saved held-out predictions; verify all graph labels come from train indices; independently confirm any AUC>0.85 winner before marking the goal complete
